data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: `tests/fixtures/arbiter/` directory contains at minimum 6 JSON fixture files: 2 BLOCK scenarios, 2 DEFER scenarios, 2 DROP scenarios
- DD2: At least one fixture covers a schema-collision scenario (input with both old SUSTAIN/ACCEPT field and new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP field present simultaneously) — arbiter must reject or normalize gracefully
- DD6: All 6+ tests pass in CI (validate.sh --ci or targeted test run)

## TDD Requirement
TDD exemption: Static assets only — these are JSON data files with no conditional logic. The test for this task is the replay script created in Task 1. Once these fixtures exist, Task 1's RED test turns GREEN.

Exemption criteria: Unit exemption criterion 3 — "static assets only (schema migrations with no branching logic, Markdown documentation, static config files) where no executable assertion is possible."

## Fixtures to Create

Create `tests/fixtures/arbiter/` directory with 7 JSON files:

### 1. block-01-critical-no-defense.json (BLOCK scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "BLOCK ruling: severity=critical, defense absent (empty), cycle within max_cycles. BLOCK-gate AND-logic: all three conditions met.",
  "scenario": "BLOCK",
  "expected_ruling": "BLOCK",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-block-01",
    "severity": "critical",
    "dimension": "correctness",
    "cited_lines": ["src/auth/login.py:42", "src/auth/login.py:55"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "BLOCK",
    "rationale": "Defense absent; critical severity finding with no rebuttal evidence.",
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 2,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": false
}
```

### 2. block-02-critical-defense-rejected.json (BLOCK scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "BLOCK ruling: severity=critical, defense submitted but arbiter rejected it (ruling=BLOCK). Cycle within max_cycles.",
  "scenario": "BLOCK",
  "expected_ruling": "BLOCK",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-block-02",
    "severity": "critical",
    "dimension": "security",
    "cited_lines": ["src/api/endpoint.py:123"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "BLOCK",
    "rationale": "Defense cites general assertions; no specific line evidence negates the security finding.",
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 1,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": true,
  "defense_text": "The endpoint is not exposed to external traffic."
}
```

### 3. defer-01-max-cycles-exceeded.json (DEFER scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "DEFER ruling: cycle > max_cycles. CoVe soft-cap fallback — arbiter emits DEFER regardless of severity when cycle count is exhausted.",
  "scenario": "DEFER",
  "expected_ruling": "DEFER",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-defer-01",
    "severity": "important",
    "dimension": "correctness",
    "cited_lines": ["src/services/processor.py:87"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "DEFER",
    "rationale": "Cycle count (5) exceeds max_cycles (4); arbiter emits DEFER per CoVe soft-cap policy.",
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 5,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": false
}
```

### 4. defer-02-noncritical-defense-absent.json (DEFER scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "DEFER ruling: severity=minor (non-critical), defense absent. BLOCK-gate requires critical/important severity; minor finding without defense gets DEFER.",
  "scenario": "DEFER",
  "expected_ruling": "DEFER",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-defer-02",
    "severity": "minor",
    "dimension": "style",
    "cited_lines": ["src/utils/helpers.py:12"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "DEFER",
    "rationale": "Severity is minor; BLOCK-gate requires critical or important severity. Emitting DEFER.",
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 3,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": false
}
```

### 5. drop-01-accepted-defense-new-evidence.json (DROP scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "DROP ruling via ACCEPT_DEFENSE path: defense accepted because named_rebuttal references a new file:line NOT in reviewer_severity_evidence. validate_arbiter_ruling preserves DOWNGRADE_TO ruling, which maps to DROP.",
  "scenario": "DROP",
  "expected_ruling": "ACCEPT_DEFENSE",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-drop-01",
    "severity": "critical",
    "dimension": "correctness",
    "cited_lines": ["src/auth/login.py:42"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "DOWNGRADE_TO_style",
    "severity_rebuttal": {
      "reviewer_claimed_severity": "critical",
      "reviewer_severity_evidence": "src/auth/login.py:42",
      "named_rebuttal": "src/auth/login.py:99 demonstrates that the null-check was added in the refactoring."
    },
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 2,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": true
}
```

### 6. drop-02-accept-defense-no-rebuttal-refs.json (DROP scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "DROP ruling via ACCEPT_DEFENSE reclassification: named_rebuttal has no file:line references. validate_arbiter_ruling reclassifies DOWNGRADE_TO to ACCEPT_DEFENSE because no new evidence is cited.",
  "scenario": "DROP",
  "expected_ruling": "ACCEPT_DEFENSE",
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-drop-02",
    "severity": "important",
    "dimension": "correctness",
    "cited_lines": ["src/services/validator.py:33"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "DOWNGRADE_TO_minor",
    "severity_rebuttal": {
      "reviewer_claimed_severity": "important",
      "reviewer_severity_evidence": "src/services/validator.py:33",
      "named_rebuttal": "The behavior is actually intended by design per the spec document."
    },
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "cycle": 3,
  "max_cycles": 4,
  "defense_present": true
}
```

### 7. schema-collision-01-old-and-new-fields.json (Schema-collision scenario)
```json
{
  "_comment": "Schema-collision scenario: fixture contains both old schema fields (SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY, ACCEPT_DEFENSE as ruling enum values in old trinary schema) AND new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP fields. Expected handling: new schema takes precedence OR graceful rejection with actionable error.",
  "scenario": "SCHEMA_COLLISION",
  "expected_handling": "graceful",
  "expected_ruling_field_present": true,
  "finding": {
    "id": "f-collision-01",
    "severity": "critical",
    "dimension": "correctness",
    "cited_lines": ["src/auth/login.py:42"]
  },
  "arbiter_ruling": {
    "ruling": "BLOCK",
    "old_schema_ruling": "SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY",
    "rationale": "Defense rejected. Old schema field present for backward compat test.",
    "schema_version": "3"
  },
  "old_schema_present": true,
  "cycle": 1,
  "max_cycles": 4
}
```

## Implementation Notes

Create the directory and all 7 files. Each file must be valid JSON (verify with `python3 -m json.tool`).

The `expected_ruling` field for drop scenarios is `ACCEPT_DEFENSE` (not DROP) because `validate_arbiter_ruling` maps DOWNGRADE_TO → ACCEPT_DEFENSE per the reclassification logic. The replay test for drop scenarios calls `validate_arbiter_ruling(fixture['arbiter_ruling'], fixture['finding'])` and asserts `result['ruling'] == fixture['expected_ruling']`.

For BLOCK/DEFER scenarios, the replay test validates:
1. `arbiter_ruling.ruling` field matches expected_ruling
2. Required schema fields present: `ruling`, `rationale`, `schema_version`
3. No old schema strings (SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY, ACCEPT_DEFENSE, DOWNGRADE_TO) in `arbiter_ruling.ruling` field for BLOCK/DEFER scenarios

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] tests/fixtures/arbiter/ directory exists with at least 7 files
  Verify: test -d $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter && [ $(ls $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -ge 7 ]
- [ ] All 7 fixture files are valid JSON
  Verify: for f in $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done
- [ ] Exactly 2 BLOCK scenario fixtures exist
  Verify: grep -l '"scenario": "BLOCK"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 != 2)}'
- [ ] Exactly 2 DEFER scenario fixtures exist
  Verify: grep -l '"scenario": "DEFER"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 != 2)}'
- [ ] Exactly 2 DROP scenario fixtures exist
  Verify: grep -l '"scenario": "DROP"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 != 2)}'
- [ ] At least 1 schema-collision fixture exists
  Verify: grep -l '"scenario": "SCHEMA_COLLISION"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 1)}'
- [ ] All fixtures have a _comment field
  Verify: for f in $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/arbiter/*.json; do python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$f')); sys.exit(0 if '_comment' in d else 1)" || exit 1; done
- [ ] replay test passes after fixtures created (Task 1's test turns GREEN)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-cycle-arbiter.sh
data.title: Create tests/fixtures/arbiter/ corpus with 7 canonical BLOCK/DEFER/DROP/schema-collision fixtures
